text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on Mortimer Avenue, City Council approval of this report is required. City Council, at its meeting on October 9 and 10, 2024, directed Transportation Services to provide a status update on a number of directives related to the corridor safety review on Mortimer Avenue, between Pape Avenue and Broadview Avenue. This report provides updates on these directives.
City Council on April 23 and 24, 2025, adopted the following: 1. City Council receive the report (March 18, 2025) from the Director, Traffic Management, Transportation Services for information.
